manifest.purpose: Hardened replacement for inputs/scatter_gather.cpp. Keeps exact signature: extern "C" int scatter_gather_copy(const unsigned char* src, unsigned int src_len, unsigned char* dst, unsigned int dst_len, const unsigned int* offsets, const unsigned int* lengths, unsigned int desc_count). Two-pass design: (1) validation pass over all desc_count entries (desc_count capped at 64, else reject) using 64-bit widened arithmetic (uint64_t) for offsets[i]+lengths[i] vs dst_len, and a running uint64_t src_offset accumulator plus lengths[i] vs src_len, rejecting on any overflow-prone or out-of-bounds descriptor including offset+length==dst_len being valid and >dst_len invalid (SR1,SR3,SR4); (2) only if all entries pass, a second pass performs std::memcpy(dst+offsets[i], src+running_src_offset, lengths[i]) for each entry in order, updating running_src_offset. If desc_count==0 returns 0 immediately without touching dst or dereferencing offsets/lengths (FR4). On any validation failure returns nonzero and dst is never written (SR2). No dynamic allocation, no signed overflow, deterministic. Must compile cleanly with g++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra with no unused-variable warnings (use (void) casts where needed).
